author: ComradeCactus
name: anonymouspoll
short: Post anonymous button polls with a command.
description: Start a button-based poll in the current channel. Voters are hidden; only totals are shown. Polls persist across restarts and post results when they end.
install_msg: Use `/anonymouspoll` (pop-up form) or `/anonymouspoll-text` to start a poll without showing who started it. Admins can use `/anonymouspoll-log` to log poll starters to a channel. Requires discord.py 2.7+ (Red 3.5.24+). Votes are only shown as totals.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores the user IDs of voters, and which choices they picked, for the duration of each open poll. It is deleted when the poll ends.
